Thanks for flagging this, Priyom. Quick guidance from tax/compliance: we prefer the customer-provided state resale certificate that contains purchaser name, purchaser address, and purchaser EIN (or state registry number) plus a signature/date.

If the scanned PDF is missing a signature or EIN, our options are:
- Ask the customer for a corrected signed certificate (preferred) — DocuSign works and is fastest.
- If customer cannot provide signed certificate same-day, accept a combination of: W-9 (for EIN) + procurement email attestation + scanned certificate (as interim evidence). We can allow a 14-day window to receive the signed certificate; during that window we can hold the invoice tax-exempt if AP provides the W-9 and explicit attestation.

Priyom, please send a short DocuSign link with our standard resale template (I can paste the template text if needed). CC compliance@redwood.com if they take the attestation route so we get it logged.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Hi Elaine — thanks for sending the scanned certificate. Quick follow-up per our tax team:

We can do one of two things to get Invoice RED-9712 cleared as tax-exempt right away:

1) Preferred: Please sign a state resale certificate that includes Summit Retailers' EIN and return a signed PDF. I've sent a short DocuSign request (link below) pre-filled with Summit Retailers' name to make this fast. It should take <5 minutes to sign.

DocuSign link (redwood-template): https://docusign.com/signed/placeholder-12345

2) Interim (if you can't sign immediately): Reply with a copy of your W-9 showing the EIN and a brief procurement email confirming Summit's claim of resale exemption for NJ and CT. If we receive those within 14 days we will hold the invoice tax-exempt pending the signed certificate. Please CC compliance@redwood.com on that reply.

If you choose DocuSign I will mark the invoice held and clear it on receipt of the signed certificate. If you choose the interim route we'll need the W-9 + attestation to avoid re-invoicing.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — let me know if you want me to open the DocuSign on your behalf.
